summary.plain: Super-Kamiokande's most complete measurement yet of neutrinos streaming from the Sun, combining more than 20 years of data across all four phases of the detector to pin down how many boron-8 solar neutrinos arrive at Earth and how they mix.
summary.technical: Combines SK-I through SK-IV (5,805 live days total); SK-IV alone contributes 2,970 days (Oct. 2008 - May 2018) and 65,443 solar-neutrino events. Reports an 8B solar-neutrino flux and oscillation parameters (sin^2 theta_12, Delta m^2_21) in mild tension with the complementary KamLAND reactor measurement.

title: Solar neutrino measurements using the full data period of Super-Kamiokande-IV
why_it_matters: Super-Kamiokande's most precise, longest-baseline solar-neutrino measurement, testing the MSW-LMA solar-oscillation solution and probing for any energy-dependent deviation (the 'upturn') that would signal new physics beyond standard three-flavour oscillation.
